$schema_purpose: Canonical machine-readable taxonomy vocabulary for the Pestana AI email agent. Defines all labels and values predicted by the LLM. Pydantic enums, classification prompts, and dashboard label sets all derive from this file. See taxonomy_proposal.md for full prose specification.
v1_1_changes: taxonomy_v1_1: kept the 7 categories; added the inquiry_answer_source facet (RAG-safety signal) and the request_type value ancillary_service_request; renamed expects_human_response -> requires_human_followup; booking_lifecycle_stage now = stage of the booking REFERENCED (inquiries may carry one). Wired live 2026-06-28. rag_candidate is derived in code: category==service_or_information_inquiry AND inquiry_answer_source==kb_policy. Full rationale: DESIGN_NOTE_taxonomy.md Part II.

categories.name: booking_notification
categories.description: System-generated, templated email from a booking channel informing about a single booking lifecycle event. Team workflow is audit-against-PMS; reply only on mistake or follow-up question.
inclusion_criteria: New booking notifications from any channel (Booking.com, Expedia, Hotelbeds, Agoda, Synergy, Hopper, ODIGEO, EC Travel, BEMTours, Open Travel Service, BA Holidays, Schauinsland, Despegar, Juniper/Jet2, Dertour, etc.)
Paid booking confirmations
Pre-arrival / check-in reminder notifications (Mirai, Despegar)
Post-hoc modification notifications (e.g., Mirai 'Modified Reservation')
Post-hoc cancellation notifications generated by a channel that DO NOT require validation
exclusion_criteria: Channel-generated cancellations/modifications that require validation → booking_change_or_cancellation
distinguishing_signals: Channel-templated subject pattern: '<Channel> Booking for #<ID>', 'Mirai: Checkin <Month> <DD>', 'Agoda Booking ID <ID> - CONFIRMED', 'Booking Confirmation | EDR-...'
Body contains templated sections: RESERVATION DETAILS, PAYMENT DETAILS, Daily Room Rate Breakdown
No human greeting / signature in inner email body

categories.name: booking_change_or_cancellation
categories.description: Email about an existing booking that requires the team to review or validate a change (system-sent or human-written).
inclusion_criteria: Channel-generated cancellation notifications requiring validation
Channel-generated modification notifications that require validation
Human-written modification requests for existing bookings
Human-written cancellation requests / cancellation-fee negotiations
Date / room / occupancy change requests for existing bookings
exclusion_criteria: Brand-new booking requests (no prior booking) → service_or_information_inquiry
distinguishing_signals: Subject contains 'Cancellation', 'Modification', 'Cancelamento', 'Modified Reservation', 'Change of booking'
Body references a specific existing booking reference + a change action
Channel templates show 'Cancelled On:' or 'Modified On:' dates
Human messages: greeting + reference to existing booking + change verb (alterar, cancel, modify)

categories.name: service_or_information_inquiry
categories.description: Human-written email (from a guest, partner, agency, or internal Pestana staff) asking for information, making a new booking request, or requesting a service that is not a modification/cancellation of an existing booking.
inclusion_criteria: Policy / amenity / facility questions (RAG candidates)
Availability or quote inquiries
New booking requests from partners, agencies, or direct guests
Internal Pestana staff booking accommodations for technicians, staff travel, project work
Operational requests that are not lifecycle changes (airport transfer requests, special arrangements)
Withdrawals or acknowledgments of prior service inquiries
exclusion_criteria: Inquiries specifically about payment / invoice / VAT / billing → payment_billing_or_rate_issue
Modifications or cancellations of existing bookings → booking_change_or_cancellation
distinguishing_signals: Human greeting + signature
Free-form text in PT / EN / ES / DE
Request verbs: solicitamos, gostaria, please confirm, poderia, please book
Booking.com extranet relay format ('We received this message from' / 'Recebemos esta mensagem de') — guest messages via OTA
CRM case markers (Case Number: 03XXXXXX [ ref:!00D0... :ref ]) common

categories.name: payment_billing_or_rate_issue
categories.description: Email where the primary topic is payment, billing, invoices, fiscal data, rates, tariffs, or commercial contracts.
inclusion_criteria: Invoice requests, VAT / CIF / NIF / fiscal-data updates
Payment status questions, refund inquiries
Rate / tariff change requests under existing contracts
Commission disputes or partner billing questions
System-forwarded payment problem warnings (e.g., Mirai 'Problems with your credit card')
Internal finance team inquiries about a booking's financials
exclusion_criteria: Booking notification that includes a VCC field but no payment question → booking_notification
Cancellation negotiation that mentions fees but is primarily about the cancellation → booking_change_or_cancellation
distinguishing_signals: Subject or body contains: invoice, fatura, VAT, CIF, NIF, fiscal, factura, tarifa, rate, contract, pagamento, payment, refund, credit card
Money or finance is the dominant theme of the email, not a side-mention

categories.name: inventory_availability_or_stop_sales
categories.description: Email about room inventory, allotment, stop-sales, or operational availability coordination — typically a partner reply or operational thread, occasionally a system-generated availability alert.
inclusion_criteria: Partner replies to Pestana-initiated stop-sales requests
Allotment update or coordination threads
Stop-sales notifications generated by Pestana's stop-sales system
Mirai / channel availability alerts ('no availability for these dates')
Inventory blocking / release / room closure operational discussions
exclusion_criteria: Availability inquiries from a guest or partner that are part of a booking-request flow → service_or_information_inquiry
distinguishing_signals: Subject or body contains: stop sales, stop-sale, allotment, availability, inventory, paragem de vendas
Typically threads with the partner's booked-allotment position

categories.name: system_or_channel_delivery_exception
categories.description: System-generated alert, error, or exception notification from a channel manager, PMS, distribution system, or OTA infrastructure that requires technical or operations team attention.
inclusion_criteria: SiteMinder reservation delivery failure emails
Channel-manager-to-PMS delivery errors
'Reservation could not be found' / 'duplicate or unmatched reservation' messages
Channel extranet alerts requiring login (e.g., easyJet holidays Extranet alert)
exclusion_criteria: Mirai credit card warnings → payment_billing_or_rate_issue (topic is payment)
distinguishing_signals: Subject explicitly references a system or technical event: 'Siteminder reservation delivery failure', 'Booking Alert easyJet holidays Extranet'
Body contains: 'unable to be delivered to your PMS', 'could not be found'
Sender is a no-reply system address

categories.name: other_or_unclear
categories.description: Fallback for emails that cannot be confidently classified into one of the six operational categories.
inclusion_criteria: Auto-acknowledgments and contact-form confirmations with no operational content
Ambiguous emails where no category clearly dominates
Garbled, partial, or near-empty bodies after cleaning
Spam or off-topic
distinguishing_signals: No clear inclusion match for the six operational categories
LLM confidence below the routing threshold (<=0.75)

sender_type.description: Who authored the underlying email content (after stripping forwarding wrappers).

values.name: automated_system
values.description: Email originates from a channel manager, OTA, distribution system, or other system (Booking.com, Expedia, Mirai, SiteMinder, etc.).

values.name: partner_or_agency
values.description: Human author at an external travel agency, wholesaler, DMC, tour operator, or contracted partner.

values.name: direct_guest
values.description: End-traveler / customer, either directly or via an OTA extranet relay.

values.name: internal_pestana_staff
values.description: Pestana property staff, internal department, or central reservations team member.

values.name: unknown
values.description: Cannot determine.

request_type.description: What the email is asking — a DESCRIPTIVE tag (v1_1: it does NOT gate routing; the RAG gate moved to inquiry_answer_source). Useful as a dashboard/Outlook tag.

values.name: policy_or_general_question
values.description: Asking about a policy, amenity, service, or facility.

values.name: availability_or_quote_inquiry
values.description: Asking if rooms/dates are available or for a price quote.

values.name: new_booking_request
values.description: Asking to create a booking.

values.name: modification_request
values.description: Asking to change an existing booking.

values.name: cancellation_request
values.description: Asking to cancel an existing booking.

values.name: ancillary_service_request
values.description: v1_1: asking staff to arrange/provide/price a stay-related service or extra (transfer, crib, late check-in, etc.).

values.name: payment_or_billing_inquiry
values.description: Asking about payment, invoices, VAT, refunds, billing.

values.name: complaint_or_dispute
values.description: Expressing dissatisfaction, asking for resolution.

values.name: withdrawal_or_acknowledgment
values.description: Retracting a previous request or acknowledging an answer.

values.name: none
values.description: No specific request — purely informational (most automated notifications).

values.name: other_or_unclear
values.description: Cannot determine.

inquiry_answer_source.description: v1_1 RAG-safety signal — what kind of source would be required to answer the inquiry. The derived RAG gate is category==service_or_information_inquiry AND inquiry_answer_source==kb_policy. Independent of requires_human_followup.

values.name: kb_policy
values.description: Answerable from static hotel knowledge / policy / FAQ / facility info (parking, check-in, pets, breakfast, wifi, accessibility, general cancellation policy).

values.name: internal_system
values.description: Needs live booking/payment/inventory/rate/customer data (availability, quote, booking status, payment link, refund status).

values.name: human_judgment
values.description: Needs staff decision/coordination/exception/negotiation/arrangement (arrange a transfer, waive a fee, special setup).

values.name: not_applicable
values.description: No inquiry to answer (notification, system alert, thread closure).

values.name: unclear
values.description: An inquiry exists but the source needed cannot be determined.

booking_lifecycle_stage.description: Lifecycle stage of the booking REFERENCED in the email, if any (v1_1: an inquiry that references a future booking may carry pre_arrival). For channel notifications it mirrors extraction.booking_identity.notification_type. Use paid only if payment is explicitly stated.

values.name: new
values.description: Email concerns the creation of a new booking.

values.name: paid
values.description: Email concerns a booking already paid / prepaid (explicitly stated).

values.name: pre_arrival
values.description: Email concerns / references an upcoming arrival / check-in.

values.name: modified
values.description: Email concerns a modification (made or requested).

values.name: cancelled
values.description: Email concerns a cancellation (made or requested).

values.name: n/a
values.description: No booking referenced (alert, exception, general inquiry).

requires_human_followup.description: v1_1 (renamed from expects_human_response): does the email ask for/imply a human reply, decision, action, or manual review? A required extranet/link click counts. Routine audit-against-PMS does NOT. Independent of inquiry_answer_source (a system warning is not_applicable + yes).

values.name: yes
values.description: Solicits a reply, decision, action, or manual review.

values.name: no
values.description: Purely informational; no follow-up solicited ('silence = validated' -> no).

values.name: unclear
values.description: Cannot determine.

values.name: routine
values.description: Normal handling.

values.name: urgent
values.description: Explicit urgency markers: URGENT, URGENTE, PLEASE REPLY, payment-problem warnings, imminent-arrival timing.

values.name: sensitive_complaint
values.description: Complaint, dispute, dissatisfaction, sensitive issue.

audit_finding.description: Output of the audit module on booking_notification emails. Drives downstream routing.

values.name: clean
values.description: All required fields for the lifecycle stage are present and consistent.

values.name: missing_fields
values.description: One or more required fields are absent.

values.name: suspected_error
values.description: Internal inconsistency detected (e.g., check-out before check-in, currency missing while price present, occupancy mismatch).

values.name: n/a
values.description: Not applicable (category is not booking_notification).

recommended_action.description: Final routing decision produced by the Router Agent. Drives output generation and downstream handling.

values.name: audit_only
values.description: Produce audit checklist only. No human attention required beyond routine audit.

values.name: audit_with_attention
values.description: Audit checklist + surface findings (missing fields, suspected errors, or embedded remarks) for human review.

values.name: audit_only_with_note
values.description: Audit + internal note (typically for withdrawn requests).

values.name: draft_reply_with_rag
values.description: Generate a draft reply grounded in KB retrieval.

values.name: escalate_to_reservations_team
values.description: Escalate with a structured summary for the reservations team.

values.name: escalate_to_payment_or_billing
values.description: Escalate with a payment/billing-specific summary.

values.name: escalate_to_inventory_or_operations
values.description: Escalate with an inventory/availability-specific summary.

values.name: escalate_to_technical_or_operations
values.description: Escalate with a technical/system-error summary.

values.name: manual_review_unclear
values.description: Cannot route confidently. Defer to human triage.

design_principles: LLM describes (classification + extraction); router decides (handling flags + action).
Operational, not semantic — categories group emails by team handling, not topic.
Forwarding-invariant — classify by inner content, not by the forwarder.
Channel-agnostic — channel names are metadata, not categories.
MECE — every email fits exactly one category; fallback exists.
Evaluable — every category has >=5 observed examples; every facet value is observable from email content.
No empty buckets — facets are orthogonal; non-applicable values take n/a / none.
